claim: Site-local attendance editing preserves the exact source instant and remains unambiguous across daylight-saving transitions.

observations.requiredInvariant: An unchanged edit must preserve the original source instant or submit explicit authoritative time-zone/offset evidence.
Distinct source instants must not collapse to an indistinguishable consequential edit value.

claimBoundary: This is source-level independent adversarial evidence. It does not prove the backend has mutated data, and no customer, payroll, provider, deployment, authentication, database, DNS or credential state was changed.
